description: This file defines the final class WidgetContextCacheKey which encapsulates a cache key based on a context map, including methods for equality comparison, string representation, and parameter comparison, primarily used for caching in the widget framework of Apache OFBiz.

classes.name: WidgetContextCacheKey
classes.description: A cache key class for widget contexts, with custom equality and string methods to support caching logic based on context content.

methods.name: WidgetContextCacheKey
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache key with an unmodifiable copy of the provided context map.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a constant hash code (not optimal for hashing; possibly overridden to maintain consistent cache behavior).

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality between two WidgetContextCacheKey instances based on specific context fields, skipping certain known fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the cache key, excluding certain skip fields and including parameters.

methods.name: printMap
methods.description: Static method to produce a printable string from a map, filtering fields based on certain prefixes and skip list.

methods.name: parametersAreEqual
methods.description: Static method to compare two parameter maps for equality, ignoring certain fields and prefixes.
